meta_description: In-person Ayurvedic consultation in Calgary with a BAMS practitioner: 75 minutes with pulse reading, a written plan and follow-ups. $135; follow-up $75.

data.lead: The full Ayurvedic consultation, face to face in Calgary: 75 minutes with a practitioner who trained in Ayurveda for five and a half years in India, including Nadi Pariksha (pulse reading) and the traditional observation of tongue, skin, eyes and build, followed by a written plan. The same conversation as online, with the hands-on part the tradition was built around.

data.md:
## Why in person

Ayurvedic assessment has always been partly hands-on: the pulse at the wrist, the tongue, the quality of the skin and nails, how a person walks in and sits down. These are not diagnostic tests and we do not present them as such; they are the tradition's way of reading constitution and the current state, and they round out what you tell us. In person is also the route to therapies: if Abhyanga, Shirodhara or a course of Vasti fits, we can plan it on the spot and choose the oil.

## What you get

- 75 minutes with the practitioner, in a quiet room.
- Pulse reading and traditional observation, explained as we go.
- A written plan within two days: daily routine, seasonal adjustments, food, practices, therapies if they fit, and any licensed herbal product with its cautions.
- Follow-ups of 30 minutes ($75) or 45 minutes ($95), in person or online.

## While the clinic is being readied

Our Calgary clinic opens soon and the address will be published here. Until then, consultations run online, and in-person bookings open as the date is confirmed. A free 15-minute call is the quickest way to find out where things stand.

data.heading: Who it suits
items: Calgarians who want the full traditional assessment
Anyone planning therapies: the consultation chooses the oil and the course
Families familiar with Ayurveda from India who want a practitioner trained there
People who find a conversation easier in a room than on a screen
Clients combining the consultation with Abhyanga the same day ($230 together)

items.title: Before
items.text: A short intake through the booking system: contact details, what brings you, current medications and supplements. No health details are collected on this website.

items.title: The conversation (about 60 minutes)
items.text: Your history, your days: how you sleep, eat and digest, your energy through the day, your work, the season. In person this includes Nadi Pariksha (pulse reading) and a look at the tongue, skin and eyes; online we ask more questions instead.

items.title: The plan (about 15 minutes)
items.text: What Ayurveda makes of it, in plain words, and a written plan sent within two days: daily routine, food, a few practices, any therapies that fit, and any licensed herbal product worth considering, with its cautions. We say clearly when something is your physician's job.

items.title: Follow-up
items.text: A 30-minute follow-up ($75) two to four weeks on, to adjust. Most clients need two or three follow-ups over a season, not a standing appointment.

data.heading: When a consultation is not the right step
items: A medical emergency, or symptoms that are new, severe or getting worse: your physician or 911 first
Anyone who needs a diagnosis; we do not diagnose, and we will say so
Children under 16 without a parent present and their physician aware
People who want to stop a prescribed medication: that is a conversation with the prescriber, not with us

faqs.a: No. Maheswari Vedhachalam holds a Bachelor of Ayurveda Medicine and Surgery from India, where graduates practise as Ayurvedic physicians. In Canada that degree is not a licence to practise medicine, and Ayurveda is not a regulated profession; she practises as an Ayurveda Practitioner and does not use the title "Dr."

faqs.q: Can I bring a family member?
faqs.a: Yes. Many clients bring a partner or parent, and we can interpret between Tamil and English.
Consultations are generally not covered. Abhyanga booked with the consultation is massage therapy by our RMT and is receipted.
